newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 21.

text.p: the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these
items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Editorial in government daily says left is "balkanised" in Ivory Coast; highlights schism in Ivorian Popular Front (FPI) of veteran opposition leader Laurent Gbagbo.
- Six people jailed for between three and five years for offences committed during 1995 presidential election campaign
when an "active boycott" by main opposition led to violence.
